entities.summary: The Ōgon Shrine  also known as the Jinguashi Shinto Shrine, Gold Temple or Spirits of the Mountain Shrine  is a Shinto shrine located halfway up a mountain in the Gold Ecological Park in Jinguashi, Ruifang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan.
